_comment_about_this_file: This is a TEMPLATE / SCHEMA REFERENCE for the TEMPO workout planner. Every option TEMPO supports is shown below. Send this whole file to ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini and ask it to generate a custom plan in the same shape — every field is explained inline so the AI knows exactly what's allowed.
_comment_format: REQUIRED — must be exactly 'tempo-workout-plan'. Used by TEMPO to recognize the file.
_comment_version: REQUIRED — currently 1. Reserved for future schema upgrades.
name: My Custom Plan
_comment_name: REQUIRED — human-readable plan name shown in the Plan tab.
description: Optional short description of the program — goals, philosophy, anything.
_comment_description: OPTIONAL — free-text description shown in the Plan tab header.
_comment_days: REQUIRED — array of day objects. Must contain all 7 days: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday. Each day has its own type. The 4 valid day types are: 'strength', 'cindy', 'rest', 'skill'.

days._comment: DAY TYPE 1 OF 4 — STRENGTH. The most common type. Normal set-by-set flow: Start Set → enter reps → Done → rest timer. This example shows every field an exercise can have.
days._comment_id: REQUIRED — lowercase day name without spaces. Must be one of: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday.
days._comment_workoutName: REQUIRED — name of this day's workout (e.g. 'Push Day', 'Legs + Core').
days._comment_type_day: REQUIRED — one of: 'strength' | 'cindy' | 'rest' | 'skill'. 'strength' = normal set-by-set flow.

exercises._comment_ex_id: REQUIRED — stable identifier (no spaces). Used to track this exercise across history even if you rename it later.
exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises._comment_sets: REQUIRED — number of sets (integer ≥ 1). The app will guide the user through this many sets.
exercises._comment_restSeconds: REQUIRED — rest duration in seconds after each set (integer ≥ 0). 90 is typical for strength, 60 for accessory work, 120+ for big compound lifts.
exercises._comment_ex_type: OPTIONAL — exercise type. One of: 'strength' (default, rep-counting) | 'timed' (hold for time, like Plank) | 'skill' (practice-based, like Handstand). If omitted, defaults to 'strength'.
exercises.note: Controlled tempo · 2-sec pause at chest · full lockout
exercises._comment_ex_note: OPTIONAL — form cues / coaching notes shown during the workout.

mediaLinks._comment_media_type: OPTIONAL but recommended if url is present. One of: 'youtube' | 'image' | 'video' | 'link'. If omitted, TEMPO will auto-detect from the URL.
mediaLinks.label: Form Tutorial
mediaLinks._comment_media_label: OPTIONAL — chip label shown in the app. If omitted, the type is used (e.g. 'YOUTUBE').

exercises._comment_mediaLinks: OPTIONAL — array of media attachments. Shown as tappable chips in the day overview and on the workout 'Get Ready' screen. TEMPO's Plan editor lets users add up to 4 per exercise (one of each type). The four valid media types are: 'youtube' (auto-detected from youtube.com / youtu.be), 'image' (.jpg/.png/.gif/.webp/.svg), 'video' (.mp4/.webm/.mov), 'link' (anything else).

exercises._comment_2: Minimal exercise — only required fields. This is the shortest valid exercise object.
exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press

exercises._comment_3: Timed exercise — for holds like Plank. Type='timed'. The reps the user enters are actually seconds, but TEMPO treats it the same way.
exercises.name: Plank
exercises.note: Time under tension · neutral spine · breathe normally

exercises._comment_4: Skill exercise — for skill practice within a strength day. Type='skill'. Usually 1 set with longer rest.
exercises.name: Handstand Practice
exercises.note: Wall holds → shoulder taps → freestanding attempts

days._comment: DAY TYPE 2 OF 4 — CINDY. AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) mode. 20-minute countdown + round counter. Used for the famous 'Cindy' CrossFit workout but works for any AMRAP scheme.
days._comment_cindy_day: type='cindy'. The exercises array MUST be empty []. The actual workout is defined in the 'cindy' object below.
days._comment_cindy_exercises: REQUIRED — must be an empty array [] for cindy days. (TEMPO will migrate legacy plans that put exercises here, but new plans should use the cindy object.)
days.note: 20-minute AMRAP. Cycle through the scheme as many times as possible. Track total completed rounds.
days._comment_cindy_note: OPTIONAL — instructions shown on the day overview.
days._comment_cindy_durationSeconds: OPTIONAL at day level — duration in seconds. Default 1200 (20 min). Also stored inside cindy.durationSeconds.

cindy._comment_cindy_object: REQUIRED for cindy days — defines the AMRAP structure.
cindy._comment_cindy_dur: REQUIRED — countdown duration in seconds. 1200 = 20 minutes. 600 = 10 minutes. 1800 = 30 minutes.

scheme.name: Pull-ups
scheme._comment_scheme_reps: REQUIRED — reps of this movement per round.

cindy._comment_scheme: REQUIRED — array of movements performed each round. User completes one round = one entry of each movement at the listed reps, then repeats until time runs out.

days._comment: DAY TYPE 3 OF 4 — REST. No workout. User just logs an optional activity note (e.g. 'light walk'). Used for recovery / backup days.
days._comment_rest_day: type='rest'. No exercises, no cindy object. Just an optional restNote.
days._comment_rest_exercises: REQUIRED — must be empty array [] for rest days.
days.restNote: Light cardio, mobility, or full rest. Recovery is when you actually get stronger.

days._comment: DAY TYPE 4 OF 4 — SKILL. Reserved for pure skill-practice days. Behaves like a strength day but the exercises are typically type='skill' with 1 set and longer practice time. NOTE: TEMPO currently renders skill days the same as strength days — the distinction is mostly semantic. You can also just use type='strength' with type='skill' exercises inside.

exercises.name: Handstand Practice
exercises.note: Wall holds → shoulder taps → freestanding attempts · 10–15 min total

exercises.name: Muscle-up Progression
exercises.note: Pull-up → high pull-up → chest-to-bar → band-assisted → muscle-up

days._comment: STRENGTH DAY WITH MEDIA LINKS — second strength day showing a fuller Push/Pull/Legs style example.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.note: Hip hinge · controlled eccentric · no bouncing

days.restNote: Free day. Do what you enjoy — or nothing at all.

days._comment: STRENGTH DAY — minimal example with only required fields. This is the shortest valid strength day.

_comment_summary:
QUICK REFERENCE — every option TEMPO supports:

DAY TYPES (day.type): 'strength' | 'cindy' | 'rest' | 'skill'
EXERCISE TYPES (exercise.type): 'strength' | 'timed' | 'skill'  (different from day types!)
MEDIA TYPES (mediaLinks.type): 'youtube' | 'image' | 'video' | 'link'

REQUIRED PLAN FIELDS: format, version, name, days[]
REQUIRED DAY FIELDS: id, day, workoutName, type, exercises[]
REQUIRED EXERCISE FIELDS: id, name, sets, restSeconds
OPTIONAL EXERCISE FIELDS: type, note, mediaLinks[]
REQUIRED CINDY FIELDS (if type='cindy'): cindy.durationSeconds, cindy.scheme[]
REQUIRED SCHEME FIELDS: id, name, reps
OPTIONAL SCHEME FIELDS: mediaLinks[]
OPTIONAL REST FIELDS (if type='rest'): restNote

LEGACY TYPES STILL ACCEPTED ON IMPORT (auto-migrated): 'strength_skill' → 'strength', 'amrap' → 'cindy', 'cardio' → 'rest'.

VALID DAY IDS: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday (all 7 must be present, order doesn't matter).
